title: no-redundant-condition-after-falsy-int-checks (clean-room semantics)

ground_truth.statement: The integer initially narrowed to zero can become nonzero during iteration; the inner falsy check is not always true.

notes: The local source is a lead, not an oracle. Fixture and deterministic controls are re-derived from PHP semantics. Constant-condition diagnostics measure broad behavior, not a recommendation that every redundancy deserves a product warning. Measured with PHP 8.3.35, PHPStan 2.3.1, Psalm 6.20.0 and Mago 1.57.0. phpstan agrees with the scoped expectation; psalm agrees with the scoped expectation; mago agrees with the scoped expectation.
